findings.title: Independence scope
findings.finding: Checker authored 040/048. No 050 code was accessed, but upstream personnel independence is limited.
findings.missing_evidence: A checker with no upstream authorship for independent physical review.

findings.title: Material and installed-system qualification
findings.finding: Numeric agreement does not validate Be/core/bond strengths, curvature restraint, defects, cure stress distribution, coatings, moisture or installed loads.
findings.missing_evidence: Matched materials, panels, joints and shell tests; inherited NFIs remain open.

findings.title: Weather meaning
findings.finding: The maps are conditional profiles and rectangular parameter samples; family designs change geometry. Percentiles and grid fractions are not operational probabilities.
findings.missing_evidence: A selected build, site and mission joint weather/thermal history.

findings.title: Cold boundary and numerical domain
findings.finding: The exact marginal knot depends on the scanned core domain and tolerances. The first fully feasible table point is .05 K warmer. Broader exploratory root solutions are not credited as new feasible operating designs.
findings.missing_evidence: Restrict the exclusion claim to its scanned domain and establish cold interface strength experimentally.

findings.title: Interpolation precision
findings.finding: All design-day float/least-set conclusions agree, but a full direct recomputation finds endpoint table differences above .05 kg, up to approximately .23814 kg. Selected decision-critical checkpoints remain much closer.
findings.missing_evidence: Say 'selected checkpoints within .05 kg' and retain the exact direct/interpolated ledger.

findings.title: Heater quadrature
findings.finding: The 128-zone result reproduces. An analytic positive-deficit integral differs slightly; R10 reference is 21.144629726 W/m² and 2952.347263 kg battery. Displayed card figures are unchanged.
findings.missing_evidence: Use the analytic integral or report the quadrature error; heater installation mass stays unknown.
findings.disposition: Quadrature reporting gap resolved; physical heater qualification retained.
findings.resolved_component: Independent analytic and 128-point quadrature values reproduce the owner clarification; exact difference 0.0004922966320428657 W/m² is explicitly reported.
findings.remaining: Heater installation mass and installed performance remain unqualified.

findings.title: Gas calculation scope
findings.finding: The independently defined all-geometry service bound differs from the owner's scalar sampling and inventory/volume conventions, while both retain ample reserve. No sealed-life qualification follows.
findings.missing_evidence: Equation-only gas clarification or explicitly distinguish the conservative checker sweep; measured leaks, venting and desorption remain needed.
findings.disposition: Numerical sampling/equation clarification resolved; physical and geometry-scope qualifications retained.
findings.resolved_component: Independent scalar calculation of all 160 specified endpoint geometries reproduces all five filed rows with zero recorded pressure, mass, volume or inventory differences.
findings.remaining: The original supplement covers 32 frozen-thermal candidates per radius. It does not establish a maximum over all coupled-weather geometries. Measured leakage, pore communication, conditioning, release inventory, permeability and sealed life remain unqualified.

findings.title: Thermal mechanics version
findings.finding: 050 reproduces the original 048 treatment: cure enters face/scarf demand but not global buckling or crimping. The separately filed 048 cure-inclusive sensitivity is not silently substituted into 050.
findings.missing_evidence: Retain both model versions and their scope; qualify prestress/restraint before an operational claim.
